notes.title: UPDATE 6.0
notes.notes:
> bookings can now have an icon
> the booking view now contains a short summary

notes.title: UPDATE 5.7
notes.notes:
> bookings can now be endless
> endless bookings will be updated for the next 10 years when the app is loaded
> bills now have a type (invoice / credit)
> Some content was not updated immediately when another language was selected. This has now been fixed.

notes.title: UPDATE 5.6
notes.notes:
> steamid is no longer cached in a text file
> by non-existing bills, the number of open bills is now displayed correctly

notes.title: UPDATE 5.5
notes.notes:
> a cycle can now be set when generating bills
> dialog filter grouped when adding an attachment
> when deleting old backup copies of the database, only JSON files are now considered
> design adjustments

notes.title: UPDATE 5.4
notes.notes:
> open invoices in the dashboard can now be confirmed with the middle mouse button
> open invoices in the dashboard are now updated automatically
> points of the annual diagram in the dashboard are now clickable and forward to the calendar view
> small design adjustments

notes.title: UPDATE 5.3
notes.notes:
> invoices are no longer fixed on the first day of the month
> Invoices are grouped in the calendar view
> Invoices in the calendar view can no longer be sorted manually
> the amount of the invoice can now be written with separators
